title: Paloma Top-Up & Bill Pay Tariff: Service Fees, Card Funding Fees and Exchange Margins
content:
**Schedule of charges for Paloma Top-Up & Bill Pay, by product.** All fees are in US dollars; percentages apply to the order value.

| Product | Flat service fee per order | Service fee percentage of order value | Exchange-rate margin below mid-market | Credit-card funding fee | Fee per customer-requested retry |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Paloma Airtime Top-Up | $0.00 | 0.00% | 3.00% | 0.00% | $0.00 |
| Paloma Data Bundle | $0.00 | 0.00% | 3.00% | 0.00% | $0.00 |
| Paloma Electricity Token | $1.49 | 0.00% | 2.00% | 3.00% | $0.00 |
| Paloma Bill Pay Utilities | $1.99 | 0.00% | 1.50% | 0.00% | $0.00 |
| Paloma Bill Pay Television | $0.99 | 0.00% | 2.00% | 3.00% | $0.00 |
| Paloma Bill Pay School Fees | $3.99 | 0.50% | 1.25% | 0.00% | $0.00 |

**Accepted ways to pay**

| Product | Funding methods accepted |
|---|---|
| Paloma Airtime Top-Up | debit card, credit card, pay by bank |
| Paloma Data Bundle | debit card, credit card, pay by bank |
| Paloma Electricity Token | debit card, credit card, pay by bank |
| Paloma Bill Pay Utilities | ACH debit, debit card, pay by bank |
| Paloma Bill Pay Television | debit card, credit card, pay by bank |
| Paloma Bill Pay School Fees | ACH debit, debit card, pay by bank |

**Notes to the schedule**

1. The service fee percentage is charged in addition to the flat service fee of the same product; only Paloma Bill Pay School Fees has a percentage above zero.
2. The credit-card funding fee applies only to an order paid by credit card. A figure of 0.00% means either that credit card is not an accepted funding method for the product (Paloma Bill Pay Utilities, Paloma Bill Pay School Fees) or that credit-card payment carries no card funding fee (Paloma Airtime Top-Up, Paloma Data Bundle).
3. The exchange-rate margin is the percentage below the mid-market rate at which the local value of the order is converted.
4. The retry fee is $0.00 for every product, so a customer-requested retry carries no fee under this schedule.

**Reading the schedule (hypothetical orders).** A Paloma Bill Pay Television order paid by credit card carries the $0.99 flat service fee and a 3.00% card funding fee on the order value. The same order paid by debit card carries the $0.99 flat service fee only. A Paloma Bill Pay Utilities order cannot be paid by credit card, because credit card is not among its accepted funding methods.
